data.description: 辞去警服后的泰拉荒原，残阳如血。身着行者风衣的陈背负双剑孑然独行，风沙掠过墨绿色双马尾与龙尾，身影在古道尽头挺拔如松——「龙门的陈警司已经留在昨天了。前路还长，走吧。」
data.lighting: 落日红光照亮夹克迎风的一侧，远崖沉在冷影里
data.promptProse: Ch’en walks into the wind toward a broken sandstone arch on an ancient road through the Terran badlands. She glances back over one shoulder, leaving both sword handles visible above her dusty sage-green hooded jacket. The black scabbard crosses the shorter red one between her shoulders. Wind tugs at her ribbons, and the rust-red sunset picks out the grit at the edge of the rutted track. The path curls through the arch and toward blue-shadowed cliffs.
data.title: 陈 · 荒野古道独行
data.animaCaption: As she heads toward the sandstone arch, Ch'en glances back over her shoulder. A black scabbard and a red scabbard cross high on her jacket, their two hilts visible above her shoulders.
